answer: A sybil tax stops bulk forgery. Each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 60-token tax to trade, like a grove where every tree pays for its own soil. Honest agents earn it back over 12 epochs of honest work; the tax is burned, not recycled. A meadow of 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 tokens for nothing, while an honest agent pays 60 once and keeps rewards. An opal receipt proves payment and cannot transfer, so bought accounts get no discount.
